does: Builds a RollFinishedEntry (type 21) for each SkillCheckEvent: roller and subject as net entities, success, critical, the stats expression and the roll result. Skips an event whose spell has CombatLogSetSingleLineRoll, a failed Perception, Survival or Investigation check while the ruleset modifier HIDE_FAILED_PERCEPTION_ROLLS is on, and an event with +0x158 equal to 1 while DIALOGUE_PASSIVE_ROLL_HIDE is on.

evidence.says: spell prototype flag bit 11 (CombatLogSetSingleLineRoll); ruleset modifier guids 19e33ff1 (HIDE_FAILED_PERCEPTION_ROLLS) and 38fc0d10 (DIALOGUE_PASSIVE_ROLL_HIDE); three string constants Perception, Survival, Investigation compared with the stats expression when Success is false

Osi.RequestPassiveRoll and the Stealth checks of Hide each give one RollFinished entry from this pass; with HIDE_FAILED_PERCEPTION_ROLLS written true a failed passive Perception gives none while a failed Athletics still gives one; written false, the failed Perception gives one

questions.ask: which rolls carry +0x158 = 1 (seen 0 for a story passive roll, 2 for Stealth, 8 for a passive Perception); a dialogue passive roll is the candidate
